header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.tamil_translation: does not show mercy to the young, and does not recognise the rights of the Ulama, is not of my Ummah,” Rasulullah ﷺ said, as Hazrat Ubadah ibn Samit (RA) narrates.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ اُمَامَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اُوْصِي الْخَلِيْفَةَ مِنْ بَعْدِيْ بِتَقْوَي اللهِ، وَاُوْصِيْهِ بِجَمَاعَةِ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ، اَنْ يُعَظِّمَ كَبِيْرَهُمْ، وَيَرْحَمَ صَغِيْرَهُمْ، وَيُوَقِّرَ عَالِمَهُمْ، وَاَنْ لَا يَضْرِبَهُمْ فَيُذِلَّهُمْ، وَلَا يُوَحِّشَهُمْ فَيُكْفِرَهُمْ، وَاَنْ لَا يُخْصِيَهُمْ فَيَقْطَعَ نَسْلَهُمْ، وَاَنْ لَا يُغْلِقَ بَابَهُ دُوْنَهُمْ فَيَأْكُلَ قَوِيُّهُمْ ضَعِيْفَهُمْ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Umamah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “I give my final advice to my Khalifah (successor) who comes after me: that he should fear Allah Ta'ala; and concerning the unity of the Muslims; that he should respect the elders among the Muslims; that he should show mercy to the young among them; that he should honour the Ulama among them; that he should not beat the Muslims to the extent that they are humiliated; that he should not frighten them to the extent that they abandon Islam; that he should not castrate them so that they are left without offspring; and that he should not shut his doors when they come to him with their complaints, for if he does so, the strong among them will devour the weak. (Injustice will spread.)”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ﵂ قَالَتْ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ الله ﷺ: اَقِيْلُوْا ذَوِي الْهَيْئَاتِ عَثَرَاتِهِمْ اِلَّا الْحُدُوْدَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب في الحد يشفع فيه رقم:٤٣٧٥
